_comment: The approved seed-4815 run, as data. This file plus format_spec.py reproduces that take's prompt byte for byte; selftest.py asserts it. Nothing here is format knowledge - every field is a creative choice this brand made.

product.appearance: same white body, same dark blackletter lettering, same gold illustration
product.colour_ban: It never turns gold or yellow.
product.opening_extra: and no ring pull is touched

location.description: a wide pavement on one street corner outside a red brick building wrapped in green scaffolding, with a bus shelter to the left, parked cars along the kerb and bare plane trees behind
location.landmarks: The same scaffolding, bus shelter and parked cars

question: Quick question. What's in this can?
props: a carrier bag, a phone, a backpack

a heavyset balding man in a paint-stained work jacket

shots._comment: The trailing comma on `subject` is deliberate and is used verbatim: the approved payload reads '...across her chest, on that same corner' while shot 3 reads '...work jacket on that same corner'. Kept so the approved prompt reproduces exactly.
shots.subject: a woman in her thirties in teal medical scrubs with a bag strap across her chest,
A young woman in a yellow raincoat with a backpack

brand_layer._comment: Everything drawn locally with PIL. No model renders a letter. `cuts` are the take's OWN internal cuts, MEASURED off seed 4815 with ffmpeg scene detection - never calculated from the script. Caption spans are MEASURED off the take's Whisper word timings (question 0.00-1.64, 5.30-6.64, 7.58-8.94, 10.74-11.90) and clamped inside the shot they belong to.
brand_layer._ambience_gap_comment: A speech-free window in THIS take, in seconds: start, duration. The ambience bed and the end card's room tone are both cut from it, so they are literally the same street on the same afternoon. It is per-take and must be measured: seed 4802's gap was at 7.6s, which on seed 4815 is the middle of 'something that's gonna kill me'. A bed built over speech loops that speech under the whole video, which is what the operator's 'random background noises' turned out to be.
captions: WE ASKED PEOPLE|WHAT'S IN THIS CAN.
We asked people what's in this can.

grade._comment: SOLVED against ld-single-seed4815.mp4 by fit_grade.py, not a constant. Per-take: re-solve after any new generation. Verified black 8.78 (band 7.0-10.3), face_sat 0.239 (band 0.14-0.228).
